phase0_exit: PASSED - Core scan pipeline (P0.3) works end-to-end

phase1_summary.P1.1: Supply chain: added dependency file parsing (requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/package.json), fixed response schemas. 52 packages registered, SBOM generation, typosquatting detection all verified.
phase1_summary.P1.2: CI/CD: quality gate evaluation already fully implemented. Fixed response schemas. Gate correctly evaluates severity counts against configurable thresholds.
phase1_summary.P1.3: Privacy: added regex PII pattern detection (SSN, CC, email, phone, IP, DOB, passport, financial), implemented DB-backed PII exposure analysis, added POST /pii-scan endpoint. PIA runs end-to-end with framework compliance checks.
phase1_summary.P1.4: Threat intel: 27 MITRE ATLAS techniques cataloged, 63% coverage. Feed/item CRUD, payload generation (template + LLM), coverage analysis all verified.
phase1_summary.P1.5: Cross-model: comparison framework with probe execution against N models, category comparison, security ranking. Fixed response schemas. 7 providers, 12 attack categories.

phase2_summary.P2.1: New storage models: GuardrailSet (guardrail_sets table) and Explanation (explanations table) with full FK relationships to tenants, scans, findings.
phase2_summary.P2.2: Finding verification columns: added verification_status, verification_model, verification_reasoning, verified_at to findings table.
phase2_summary.P2.3: Migration (a1b2c3d4e5f6), repositories (GuardrailSetRepository, ExplanationRepository), and DI wiring (GuardrailSetRepo, ExplanationRepo type aliases).
phase2_summary.P2.4: Auto-persist on all generation endpoints: guardrails POST saves GuardrailSet, all 4 explainability POST endpoints save Explanation, verify endpoint persists to verification columns. GET endpoints: guardrails by-id and by-scan, explanations by-finding and by-scan with type filter. Fixed explain_scan include_similar bug and verified_at timezone-naive datetime fix.

phase3_summary.P3.1: Event wiring: Added SCAN_PROGRESS to progress bridge, EXPLANATION_GENERATED to all 4 explainability POST endpoints, REMEDIATION_PLAN_GENERATED to remediation endpoint, GUARDRAIL_GENERATED (new event type) to guardrails endpoint, REPORT_GENERATED to report generation, PROBE_STARTED/COMPLETED/FAILED to interrogation, AUTH_SUCCESS/AUTH_FAILURE to auth middleware. Total active event types: 24+ (up from 14).
phase3_summary.P3.2: Metrics instrumentation: mass_scans_total (counter with profile label), mass_scans_active (gauge), mass_findings_total (counter), mass_findings_by_severity (counter with severity label), mass_probe_executions_total (counter), mass_worker_jobs_processed/failed (counters). Existing mass_api_requests_total and mass_api_latency_seconds in logging middleware verified working. /metrics endpoint returns Prometheus text format.

phase4_summary.P4.1: RAG pipeline analyzer: new analyzers/rag/ module with 8 risk patterns (RAG-001 through RAG-008). Wired into orchestration: RAG_ANALYSIS job type in planner, handler in executor, rag_analyzer in profiles (standard+comprehensive enabled), RAG file detection in service.
phase4_summary.P4.2: AI-BOM generation: CycloneDX-compatible JSON output in reporting/formats/aibom.py. Extracts models, frameworks, tools, data sources, infrastructure, prompt references, and vulnerabilities. New AIBOM format in ReportFormat enum. Available via format=aibom in reports API.
phase4_summary.P4.3: Adaptive probe generation: LLM-assisted mutation in probes/adaptive.py. Takes blocked probes, uses LLM to generate mutations, re-executes against target. Tracks mutation lineage. Enabled in comprehensive profile (2 rounds, 5 mutations/round). Integrated into ProbeExecutor.
phase4_summary.P4.4: Multi-modal probe support: probes/multimodal/ with TextInImageProbe, VisualInstructionProbe, SteganographicProbe. Renders attack text into PNG images using Pillow. Base64 encoding for vision model endpoints. Graceful degradation without Pillow.
phase4_summary.P4.5: Scheduled/recurring scans: cron_scheduler.py with 5-field cron expression parser. Queries deployments with scan_schedule, dispatches to Redis queue on match. Added scan_schedule and scan_schedule_profile columns to Deployment model.
phase4_summary.P4.6: Remediation verification: POST /{scan_id}/verify-finding/{finding_id} endpoint in scans.py. Calls existing verify_finding() service, updates verification columns on finding.
phase4_summary.P4.7: Confidence calibration: orchestration/calibration.py with CalibrationEngine, CalibrationStats, CalibrationProfile. Computes precision per analyzer x category from triage history, adjusts confidence scores. Added list_triaged() to FindingRepository.
